rendered: Discharge capacity of the Mn-substituted LNO cathode with 10% Mn[1] is 212 mAh g^− 1[2]. For the cathode with 50% Mn[3] it is 164 mAh g^− 1[4]. The text attributes the lower capacity at higher Mn content to the electrochemical inactivity of the manganese ions, even though higher Mn content improves cycling stability. These values are stated in the text discussing Figure Fig. 3[5] and Fig. 4[6]; no separate capacity values were read from the plotted curves.
